source.publication: 2025 Oklahoma Resident Individual Income Tax Forms and Instructions (Form 511 packet)
source.section: Form 511 lines 1-14 and 18 (PDF pages 42-43); select line instructions (PDF pages 9-10); standard deduction line 10 (PDF page 10); exemptions line 11 and the Regular exemption terms (PDF pages 8 and 10); Tax Table (PDF pages 27-38); Schedule 511-A (form PDF page 45); Schedule 511-A line 6, Other Retirement Income (PDF page 17); Special exemption and Sixty-five or older (PDF page 9)

worked: Federal AGI = wages (you) 18,650.00 + IRA distribution (you) 350.00 = 19,000.00. Federal taxable income = 19,000.00 - standard deduction 25,625.00 (23,625.00 + 1 x 2,000.00 for 65 or older) = -6,625.00, floored at 0.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; federal figures are given, not tested; Oklahoma starts from federal AGI). Schedule 511-A: line 6: you 350.00 in federal AGI, limit 10,000.00 - 0.00 on line 5 = 10,000.00, claims 350.00; line total 350.00; line 18 total subtractions 350.00 = 350.00. Form 511: line 1 federal AGI 19,000.00; line 2 subtractions 350.00; line 3 = 19,000.00 - 350.00 = 18,650.00; line 4 out-of-state income 0.00; line 5 18,650.00; line 6 additions 0.00; line 7 Oklahoma AGI 18,650.00; line 8 adjustments 0.00; line 9 18,650.00; line 10 standard deduction (head of household) 9,350.00; line 11 exemptions: 1 Regular + 1 Special = 2 x 1,000.00 = 2,000.00 (1 person(s) 65 or older; line 1 19,000.00 is within the 19,000.00 limit, so 1 Special); line 12 = 9,350.00 + 2,000.00 = 11,350.00; line 13 taxable income = 18,650.00 - 11,350.00 = 7,300.00; line 14 tax (the projection's brackets as numbers; the booklet prints only a table and worksheets): 0.25% x 2,000.00 = 5.0000 + 0.75% x 3,000.00 = 22.5000 + 1.75% x 2,300.00 = 40.2500; total 67.7500 = 67.75. Line 13 is under 100,000, so the form reads the tax table: row 7,300-7,350, column 'Married filing joint or head of household', PDF page 28, gives 68; expected keeps the schedule figure. Lines 15-17 credits 0.00; line 18 income tax 67.75. No dependents in the inputs; the form would add 1,000.00 for each.
accepted_approximations: The brackets are derived from the printed tax table and the 100,000-and-over worksheets; the booklet prints no schedule. Below 100,000 tax is figured on the exact income, where the booklet taxes each 50-dollar row at its midpoint and rounds. At 100,000 and over the single and separate worksheet starts from 4,562 where the schedule gives 4,561.50.
The blind and dependent exemptions and the credits are left out (not_modelled).
